meta.name: Kimetsu Gakuen: Valentine-hen
meta.description: Valentine's Day special for Kimetsu no Yaiba. The first three episodes will be released on Aniplex's official YouTube channel, while the fourth and final episode will be streamed during the Kimetsu Matsuri Online: Anime 2nd Anniversary Festival.

videos.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition Episode 1
videos.overview: It’s Valentine’s Day. Zenitsu is full of excitement and unable to calm down revisits an incident from half a year ago.

videos.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition Episode 2
videos.overview: Due to his strong desire to receive chocolates, Zenitsu seeks advice from teachers Mr. Rengoku and Mr. Tomioka on how to be more popular.

videos.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition Episode 3
videos.overview: Zenitsu continues to seek in advice on how to be more popular and approaches teacher Mr. Uzui next.

videos.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition Episode 4
videos.overview: For the past few days, there are rumors of a suspicious person lurking around the school premises. Upon seeing an illustration of the alleged perpretator, Tanjiro notices something…
